name: Sex Adventures - Mile High Club
source:
A visual novel about two young flight attendants naughty adventures on an empty private jet.

An empty flight can be boring and the girls decide to make their flight more enjoyable.

Giuliana and Chanel are two VIP air hostesses working on a private jet. They ensure that their passengers receive a premium, 5-star service on every trip.

After a demanding day of serving celebrities, royals, self-made entrepreneurs and oligarchs, the women realize that they have the whole plane just for themselves.
The two start to fool around, being firmly convinced that no one will catch them.

The atmosphere changes when Giuliana invites Chanel to take a shower with her, under the pretext that it would be better to “save water”.

Will they join the MILE HIGH CLUB? Let’s see what these two VIP air hostesses have in mind.
